title: Vardım anne

characters.MOM: a mother in her late forties with dark hair in a low bun, wearing a plum colored cardigan
characters.TEEN: a teenage boy of about sixteen with short black hair, wearing a dark green jacket
characters.OLDMOM: the same mother, now in her sixties with grey hair in a low bun, wearing a plum colored cardigan
characters.SON: a man of about thirty with short black hair and light stubble, wearing a dark green coat

scenes.text:
Annen, sen eve varmadan
hâlâ uyuyamıyor; biliyor musun?
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night, a small house with one warm glowing window, and {MOM} standing at the window looking out at the dark street, raindrops, glowing street lamp.

scenes.text:
Çocukken gece geç kalırsan,
pencerede hep yanık bir ışık bulurdun.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night street, {TEEN} walks toward a small house, looking up at a warm glowing window where a lamp is on, puddles reflecting the light.

scenes.text:
Şimdi başka bir şehirdesin;
o yine ışığı yakıp bekliyor.
scenes.prompt: At night, {OLDMOM} sits in an armchair beside a lamp near the window, a phone lying on the small table beside her, looking toward it patiently, rain on the window glass.

scenes.text:
Sen büyüdün,
ama onun beklemesi hiç büyümedi.
scenes.prompt: In a big city at night in the rain, {SON} with a dark umbrella arrives at the entrance of a tall apartment building, street lamps glowing on wet pavement.

scenes.text:
Bu gece ona sen yaz: "Vardım anne."
Bunu annene gönder.
scenes.prompt: At night, {OLDMOM} in her armchair smiles with relief at the phone glowing softly on the small table beside her, reaching to turn off the warm lamp, rain on the window.

caption:
Annen uyudu mu?

Sen eve varmadan onun gecesi bitmez. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder.
